_HOW_TO_EDIT: Section 6 — Writing, honours and publications. One entry per photograph, shown in this order. img is the file name in assets/img/news without .webp (an @2x file is used automatically where it exists); w and h are the 1x file's pixel size. seconds is how long the slide holds. g1 and g2 are the slide's background gradient, taken from the photograph's own colours. people_* are [name, designation] pairs: the name shows bold and the designation in brackets. Leave sig_*, venue_* or date_* empty to leave them out. Marathi always shows first, English second. rows_mr / rows_en set how the people are grouped on lines, by their number in people_*: [[1],[2,3]] puts person 1 alone and persons 2 and 3 together. A line too wide for a small screen splits by itself. keep lists phrases that must never break across two lines. book_ids names the books a ceremony belongs to: that slide appears fourth in those books' 'The Author Behind the Pen' section. key is each slide's permanent name: the book windows' section 'लेखणीमागची लेखिका' finds its slides by key (state-award-2013, zp-felicitation, zp-award-2009), never by position, so slides can be added or moved freely. journey_mr / journey_en (optional) are two [year, label] steps shown as a small strip in the book windows only.

slides.desc_mr: मा. पृथ्वीराज चव्हाण साहेब यांच्या हस्ते लेखिका सौ. मीना सुनिल गिरमे यांनी महाराष्ट्र राज्य आदर्श शिक्षक पुरस्कार स्वीकारला; यावेळी इतर मान्यवर मंत्र्यांची उपस्थिती होती.
slides.desc_en: Author Mrs. Meena Sunil Girme receiving the Maharashtra State Ideal Teacher Award from Hon. Prithviraj Chavan Saheb, in the presence of other distinguished ministers.

slides.title_mr: अहिल्यानगर जिल्हा परिषद आदर्श शिक्षक पुरस्कार — २००९
slides.title_en: Zilla Parishad Ahilyanagar Ideal Teacher Award — 2009
slides.desc_mr: यांच्या व इतर मान्यवरांच्या हस्ते, विद्यार्थ्यांच्या शिक्षणातील उल्लेखनीय कार्याबद्दल पढेगाव, ता. श्रीरामपूर येथील शिक्षिका सौ. मीना सुनिल गिरमे–जाधव यांना ‘जिल्हा परिषद आदर्श शिक्षक पुरस्कार’ देऊन गौरविण्यात आले.
slides.desc_en: At the hands of these and other dignitaries, Mrs. Meena Sunil Girme-Jadhav, a teacher from Padhegaon, Tal. Shrirampur, was honoured with the Zilla Parishad Ideal Teacher Award for her outstanding work in children's education.
slides.sig_mr: जिल्ह्याचा गौरव — राज्य पुरस्काराच्या (२०१३) वाटेवरील महत्त्वाचा टप्पा
slides.sig_en: The district's honour — a milestone on the road to the State award (2013)

people_en: Primary Education Officer, Zilla Parishad Nashik
slides.desc_mr: यांच्या हस्ते व इतर मान्यवरांच्या उपस्थितीत ‘गणितमित्र – भाग १’ व ‘भाग २’ या पुस्तकांचे प्रकाशन करण्यात आले.
slides.desc_en: The two books were released at the hands of these dignitaries, in the presence of other distinguished guests.
slides.sig_en: A new chapter marked by two publications.

people_mr: तत्कालीन गटशिक्षणाधिकारी, श्रीरामपूर तालुका, जि. अहिल्यानगर
people_en: Then Block Education Officer, Shrirampur Taluka, District Ahilyanagar
slides.desc_mr: यांच्या हस्ते व इतर मान्यवरांच्या उपस्थितीत ‘चला वाचूया झटपट’ या पुस्तकाचे प्रकाशन करण्यात आले.
slides.desc_en: The book was formally launched in his presence and in the presence of other distinguished dignitaries.
slides.sig_en: A new beginning in the reading journey.

slides.title_en: ‘English Primer with Phonics’ — Book Publication Ceremony
slides.desc_mr: यांच्या हस्ते व इतर मान्यवरांच्या उपस्थितीत ‘English Primer with Phonics’ या पुस्तकाचे प्रकाशन करण्यात आले.
slides.desc_en: The book was released at the hands of these dignitaries, in the presence of other distinguished guests.
slides.sig_en: The beginning of a new era in English reading.

slides.title_mr: जिल्हा परिषद, अहिल्यानगर यांच्या वतीने सत्कार
slides.desc_mr: यांच्या हस्ते, महाराष्ट्र राज्य आदर्श शिक्षक पुरस्कार मिळाल्याबद्दल पढेगाव, ता. श्रीरामपूर येथील शिक्षिका सौ. मीना सुनिल गिरमे–जाधव यांचा जिल्हा परिषद, अहिल्यानगरच्या वतीने सत्कार करण्यात आला.
slides.desc_en: At the hands of these dignitaries, Zilla Parishad, Ahilyanagar felicitated Mrs. Meena Sunil Girme-Jadhav, a teacher from Padhegaon, Tal. Shrirampur, on receiving the Maharashtra State Ideal Teacher Award.
